doc: Frames (t_ms, leg load in quiet-stand units, posture, body events, fallen) cut out of recorded runs of the real home with nobody around (the live server on :8996/:8997 and the headless play rig), and of two page pick-ups on the same rig. See docs/design/FALSE-LIFT-2026-10-11.md.

live_stand_light.why: live :8997, 2026-10-11 02:5x: a duck standing still after touching something; its legs went light for 0.3 s, the body claimed lifted 1.5 s later while the legs were back at 0.74 and it stood on the floor (z 0.116)

live_stand_light_2.why: live :8996: the same after a nose touch; the legs came back to 0.74 before the claim; it sat on the floor at 0.8-1.0

rig_flail_on_sill.why: play rig, seed 5002, 525 s: standing on a low thing (tilt 15 deg, z +1.4 cm), legs working at 2.7, trunk quiet: the body's flail test claims lifted; it sits on the thing at 1.6-1.7

rig_stand_light_a.why: play rig, seed 5003, 1021 s: after a flight the legs read 0.46-0.53 standing, the body claims lifted, it sits on the floor at 0.9

rig_stand_light_b.why: play rig, seed 5003, 1207 s: after zoomies the legs read 0.46 standing, the body claims lifted, it sits on the floor at 0.75-0.9

rig_fall_righting.why: play rig, seed 5002, 72-86 s: two falls, each righted by itself in 1.3 s and 4.8 s

rig_pick_up_seated.why: play rig, seed 4107: the page's hand lifts it while it sits and looks around; held 8 s, put down

rig_pick_up_standing.why: play rig, seed 4112: the page's hand lifts it while it stands (the body sits it in the air: the legs swing 0.8 s, then hang at 0.4); held 8 s, put down
